## 9 Production Builds & Case Studies

1. [NotesGPT](https://github.com/di0206-innovator/Notes-GPT): Local offline-capable AI study assistant with RAG vector indexing, WebLLM (WebGPU), and Ollama.
2. [Stratify](https://stratify-murex.vercel.app/): Interactive living graph connecting startup founders, angels, and accelerators.
3. [KrishiSetu](https://krishi-setu-ivory.vercel.app/): Connected AI-powered AgriTech operating system addressing Indian mandi auction inefficiencies.
4. [Healthify](https://healthify-lyart.vercel.app/): AI-powered consumer food ingredient scanner and FSSAI additive safety evaluator.
5. [Climbit Decision Engine](https://github.com/di0206-innovator/Climbit): 12-hour PromptWars sprint; deterministic TypeScript carbon engine + Zod-enforced Gemini 2.0 AI routing with 34 tests (rank 28,897 to 449).
6. [NyaySaathi](https://nyaysaathi-6qcz.vercel.app/): Sovereign legal AI platform for contract redlining and pre-litigation dossiers grounded in BNS and CPA 2019.
7. [MerchantPulse](https://merchantpulse-psi.vercel.app/): Autonomous payment recovery engine for Razorpay merchants utilizing deterministic failure state machines.
8. [Forge Goa](https://hhgoa26-eta.vercel.app/): HackerHouse Goa 2026 builder identity and squad formation platform.
9. [Brainworks](https://github.com/manasir747/Brainworks): Millimeter-wave radar and Edge TinyML safety system for zero-visibility open-cast mines (SIH 2026).

## Wispr Flow Strategy & Growth Lab

- 6-Stage Developer Adoption Flywheel: Developer Discovery $\rightarrow$ Frictionless Voice Setup $\rightarrow$ Public Code Demos $\rightarrow$ Campus Hackathon Integration $\rightarrow$ Enterprise Team Expansion $\rightarrow$ Organic Dev Advocacy.
- 4 Speculative India Growth Blueprints:
  1. *The 100-WPM Silent Hackathon*: Competitive voice-coding sprints across Indian engineering campuses.
  2. *Regional Multilingual Dictation*: Hinglish, Marathi, and Tamil developer voice dictionaries.
  3. *Open Source IDE Voice SDK*: Voice shortcuts integrated directly into VS Code, Cursor, and Neovim.
  4. *The Student Builder Grant*: Sponsoring top campus builders with Wispr Flow hardware and subscriptions.
